where.if: AND ( L.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR L.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(L.DESCRIPTION, #{keyword}) > 0 OR L.LOST_LOCATION_DETAIL LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND ( F.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR F.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(F.DESCRIPTION, #{keyword}) > 0 OR F.FOUND_LOCATION_DETAIL LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )

mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_LOST_ITEMS.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO LOST_ITEMS ( LOST_ID, USER_ID, TITLE, CATEGORY_ID, ITEM_NAME, COLOR, BRAND, LOST_LOCATION_ID, LOST_LOCATION_DETAIL, LOST_DATE, LOST_TIME, LOST_TIME_RANGE, DESCRIPTION, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{lostId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{categoryId}, #{itemName}, #{color}, #{brand}, #{lostLocationId}, #{lostLocationDetail}, #{lostDate}, #{lostTime}, #{lostTimeRange}, #{description}, #{status}, SYSDATE )

SELECT SEQ_FOUND_ITEMS.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO FOUND_ITEMS ( FOUND_ID, USER_ID, TITLE, CATEGORY_ID, ITEM_NAME, COLOR, BRAND, FOUND_LOCATION_ID, FOUND_LOCATION_DETAIL, FOUND_DATE, FOUND_TIME, FOUND_TIME_RANGE, STORAGE_ID, DESCRIPTION, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{foundId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{categoryId}, #{itemName}, #{color}, #{brand}, #{foundLocationId}, #{foundLocationDetail}, #{foundDate}, #{foundTime}, #{foundTimeRange}, #{storageId}, #{description}, #{status}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT L.LOST_ID AS ID, L.USER_ID, 'lost' AS ITEM_TYPE, L.TITLE, L.CATEGORY_ID, C.CATEGORY_NAME, L.ITEM_NAME, L.COLOR, L.BRAND, L.LOST_LOCATION_ID AS LOCATION_ID, LOC.LOCATION_NAME, L.LOST_LOCATION_DETAIL AS LOCATION_DETAIL, L.LOST_DATE AS ITEM_DATE, L.LOST_TIME AS ITEM_TIME, L.LOST_TIME_RANGE AS ITEM_TIME_RANGE, NULL AS STORAGE_ID, NULL AS STORAGE_NAME, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(L.DESCRIPTION, 4000, 1) AS DESCRIPTION, L.STATUS, L.VIEW_COUNT, L.CREATED_AT, U.USER_NAME AS WRITER_NAME, U.STUDENT_NO, NULL AS SCHOOL, IMG.IMAGE_URL FROM LOST_ITEMS L JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = L.USER_ID LEFT JOIN CATEGORIES C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = L.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS LOC ON LOC.LOCATION_ID = L.LOST_LOCATION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_ID, MIN(IMAGE_URL) AS IMAGE_URL FROM ITEM_IMAGES WHERE ITEM_TYPE = 'lost' GROUP BY ITEM_ID ) IMG ON IMG.ITEM_ID = L.LOST_ID WHERE L.LOST_ID = #{lostId}

SELECT F.FOUND_ID AS ID, F.USER_ID, 'found' AS ITEM_TYPE, F.TITLE, F.CATEGORY_ID, C.CATEGORY_NAME, F.ITEM_NAME, F.COLOR, F.BRAND, F.FOUND_LOCATION_ID AS LOCATION_ID, LOC.LOCATION_NAME, F.FOUND_LOCATION_DETAIL AS LOCATION_DETAIL, F.FOUND_DATE AS ITEM_DATE, F.FOUND_TIME AS ITEM_TIME, F.FOUND_TIME_RANGE AS ITEM_TIME_RANGE, F.STORAGE_ID, SP.STORAGE_NAME, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(F.DESCRIPTION, 4000, 1) AS DESCRIPTION, F.STATUS, F.VIEW_COUNT, F.CREATED_AT, U.USER_NAME AS WRITER_NAME, U.STUDENT_NO, NULL AS SCHOOL, IMG.IMAGE_URL FROM FOUND_ITEMS F JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = F.USER_ID LEFT JOIN CATEGORIES C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = F.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS LOC ON LOC.LOCATION_ID = F.FOUND_LOCATION_ID LEFT JOIN STORAGE_PLACES SP ON SP.STORAGE_ID = F.STORAGE_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_ID, MIN(IMAGE_URL) AS IMAGE_URL FROM ITEM_IMAGES WHERE ITEM_TYPE = 'found' GROUP BY ITEM_ID ) IMG ON IMG.ITEM_ID = F.FOUND_ID WHERE F.FOUND_ID = #{foundId}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT L.LOST_ID AS ID, 'lost' AS ITEM_TYPE, L.TITLE, L.ITEM_NAME, L.STATUS, L.CREATED_AT, LOC.LOCATION_NAME, L.LOST_LOCATION_DETAIL AS LOCATION_DETAIL FROM LOST_ITEMS L LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS LOC ON LOC.LOCATION_ID = L.LOST_LOCATION_ID WHERE #{itemType} = 'lost' UNION ALL SELECT F.FOUND_ID AS ID, 'found' AS ITEM_TYPE, F.TITLE, F.ITEM_NAME, F.STATUS, F.CREATED_AT, LOC.LOCATION_NAME, F.FOUND_LOCATION_DETAIL AS LOCATION_DETAIL FROM FOUND_ITEMS F LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS LOC ON LOC.LOCATION_ID = F.FOUND_LOCATION_ID WHERE #{itemType} = 'found' ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT L.LOST_ID AS ID, L.USER_ID, 'lost' AS ITEM_TYPE, L.TITLE, L.ITEM_NAME, L.STATUS, L.VIEW_COUNT, L.CREATED_AT, LOC.LOCATION_NAME, L.LOST_LOCATION_DETAIL AS LOCATION_DETAIL, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(L.DESCRIPTION, 1000, 1) AS DESCRIPTION FROM LOST_ITEMS L LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS LOC ON LOC.LOCATION_ID = L.LOST_LOCATION_ID WHERE L.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY L.CREATED_AT DESC )

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT F.FOUND_ID AS ID, F.USER_ID, 'found' AS ITEM_TYPE, F.TITLE, F.ITEM_NAME, F.STATUS, F.VIEW_COUNT, F.CREATED_AT, LOC.LOCATION_NAME, F.FOUND_LOCATION_DETAIL AS LOCATION_DETAIL, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(F.DESCRIPTION, 1000, 1) AS DESCRIPTION FROM FOUND_ITEMS F LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS LOC ON LOC.LOCATION_ID = F.FOUND_LOCATION_ID WHERE F.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY F.CREATED_AT DESC )

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT R.REPORT_ID, R.REPORTER_ID, U.USER_NAME AS REPORTER_NAME, R.TARGET_TYPE, R.TARGET_ID, CASE WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'lost' THEN (SELECT TITLE FROM LOST_ITEMS WHERE LOST_ID = R.TARGET_ID) WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'found' THEN (SELECT TITLE FROM FOUND_ITEMS WHERE FOUND_ID = R.TARGET_ID) ELSE NULL END AS TARGET_TITLE, R.REASON, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(R.DETAIL, 1000, 1) AS DETAIL, R.STATUS, R.CREATED_AT, R.PROCESSED_AT FROM REPORTS R JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = R.REPORTER_ID
AND (R.REASON LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(R.DETAIL, #{keyword}) > 0)
AND R.STATUS = #{status}
ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 200
